summary.health_score_note: Partial-coverage score. 5 of 8 planned specialist passes completed in full (Technical, Sitemap, GEO, SXO, and a partial Schema pass); Content Quality, Performance, and Visual/Mobile hit their analysis turn-limit before writing full findings. Weighted only across categories with real evidence -- treat as directional, not final, until those three are re-run.
summary.business_type: Independent Vespa media brand (podcast, event coverage) + curated peer-to-peer Vespa marketplace + community directory that matches Vespa clubs with event sponsors
top_findings: CRITICAL (SXO): /komunitas/ commits intent inversion -- title/meta sell a directory, H1/hero sell a B2B sponsor-matching pitch. Both the rider searching for a club and the organizer searching for sponsor help are mismatched.

CRITICAL (Technical): every mistyped/nonexistent URL returns HTTP 200 with homepage content instead of a 404 (Cloudflare Pages SPA-fallback), which Search Console will flag as soft-404s at scale across an open UUID URL space.

CRITICAL (GEO): ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, and Claude's search bots get a live HTTP 403 from a Cloudflare WAF/AI Crawl Control rule -- this is separate from and worse than the robots.txt AI-training block, and robots.txt reading alone gives a falsely reassuring answer.
HIGH (SXO): /marketplace/ ships a static empty-state ('Belum Ada Listing Saat Ini... Jadi penjual pertama di sini') to first-pass crawlers while 15 real listings exist -- injected client-side only.
HIGH (Technical): apex domain vespakita.com serves identical 200 content instead of redirecting to www -- protected only by a canonical tag, not an actual redirect.

HIGH (Sitemap): a live, unprotected '/rate-card/ (Draft Internal)' page and a third admin tool at /komunitas/tongkrongan/admin/ (password-gated but not noindexed) are both crawlable/indexable with no protection.

Cross-cutting root cause: /komunitas/, /marketplace/semua/, and the homepage 'Event' widget are all static HTML shells populated entirely by client-side fetch() -- the same architectural gap shows up independently in Technical, SXO, and GEO findings.
quick_wins: Disable Cloudflare Pages' SPA/not-found fallback and ship a real 404.html (fixes the sitewide soft-404 Critical finding)
Add a Cloudflare redirect rule: vespakita.com/* -> 301 -> www.vespakita.com/$1

In Cloudflare's AI Crawl Control / WAF settings, allow OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, and Claude-SearchBot by name -- 15 minutes of dashboard work, currently blocking 100% of ChatGPT/Perplexity/Claude search visibility
Add noindex,nofollow to /rate-card/ and /komunitas/tongkrongan/admin/, and add both to robots.txt Disallow

Rewrite /komunitas/ title+meta to match ONE intent (recommend: keep the sponsor-matching pitch since that's the actual business model, and move the directory framing to a supporting section rather than fighting it in the title tag)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Sitemap valid and correctly declared in robots.txt
Bidirectional hreflang + x-default correct on every ID/EN pair checked, including UUID dynamic pages
Self-referencing canonicals correct everywhere, including on the apex-domain duplicate
Admin path (/marketplace/admin/) has defense-in-depth: robots.txt disallow + noindex meta + password gate
Dynamic detail pages (/marketplace/l/{id}, /komunitas/c/{id}) are genuinely server-rendered, not JS-dependent, with correct per-page title/meta/canonical/hreflang
Valid Product+Offer JSON-LD on marketplace listings; Organization schema on homepage
Bad dynamic-route IDs correctly return real 404s (contrast with the sitewide soft-404 issue)
HTTP->HTTPS redirect and trailing-slash normalization both work correctly
pages.dev subdomain explicitly redirects to production domain
ID/EN content is genuinely translated (132 differing lines sampled), not a language-switcher wrapper over duplicate content

findings.title: Sitewide soft-404: every unmatched URL returns HTTP 200 with homepage content
findings.description: /nonexistent-page-xyz/, /wp-admin/, /marketplace/l/ (no ID), even /indexnow.txt all return 200 with the literal homepage HTML, title, and canonical. Root cause: Cloudflare Pages SPA-fallback mode with no real 404 handling in _redirects. Google Search Console will surface these as Soft 404s at scale given the site's open UUID URL space.
findings.recommendation: Disable the Pages project's SPA fallback and ship a real 404.html returned with an actual 404 status; leave the already-correct dynamic-route Function 404s untouched.

findings.title: Apex domain (vespakita.com) does not redirect to www
findings.description: curl -sI https://vespakita.com/ returns 200, byte-identical to the www version, relying entirely on a canonical tag rather than an authoritative redirect.
findings.recommendation: Add a Cloudflare Bulk Redirect: vespakita.com/* -> 301 -> https://www.vespakita.com/$1

findings.title: /komunitas/, /marketplace/semua/, and the homepage event widget render primary content only client-side
findings.description: Raw HTML ships empty grid containers (<div id="kom-grid">, <div id="listing-grid">) or a 'Memuat event...' placeholder, populated via fetch('/api/...'). render_page.py's non-JS extraction pulled only 470 characters of unrelated copy from /komunitas/ -- none of the actual directory content. These hub pages are the main internal-link path to the UUID detail pages; a non-JS crawler finds zero links to them here.
findings.recommendation: Server-render at minimum a plain link list from the same Functions/D1 backend already powering the API, then progressively enhance with the existing client JS.

findings.title: No HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, or Permissions-Policy headers
findings.description: Only x-content-type-options and referrer-policy are present on any page checked.
findings.recommendation: Add via a Cloudflare Pages _headers file: HSTS, a report-only CSP baseline, and X-Frame-Options at minimum on /marketplace/admin/*.

findings.title: /komunitas/tongkrongan/ disables pinch-zoom (user-scalable=no)
findings.description: No other page in the sample sets user-scalable=no. WCAG 2.1 mobile-usability anti-pattern on a chat/feed UI where zoom is a normal expectation.
findings.recommendation: Remove maximum-scale/user-scalable from the viewport tag; use touch-action: manipulation on specific interactive elements if double-tap-zoom was the actual concern.

findings.title: Images lack explicit width/height attributes
findings.description: 0 of 38 homepage tags have a width attribute; only 17/38 have loading="lazy".
findings.recommendation: Add explicit width/height or CSS aspect-ratio to reserve layout space; extend lazy-loading to remaining below-the-fold images.

findings.title: No structured data on community profile pages
findings.description: No JSON-LD at all on /komunitas/c/{id}, unlike marketplace listings which have full Product schema.
findings.recommendation: Add an Organization/Club-style JSON-LD block (name, url, logo, sameAs) to the community profile Function template.

findings.title: No IndexNow implementation
findings.description: /indexnow.txt resolves to the soft-404 homepage fallback rather than a real key file.
findings.recommendation: Wire the listing/community publish flow to ping IndexNow (Bing/Yandex/Naver) so new UUID pages are discovered faster than sitemap re-crawl alone allows.

categories.name: On-Page SEO / SXO
what_works: /marketplace/l/{id} is the strongest page on the site: server-rendered with valid Product+Offer+Brand JSON-LD, unique per-listing title/meta
Exactly one H1 on most pages checked, unique titles/descriptions

findings.title: /komunitas/ is two pages fighting each other (intent inversion)
findings.description: SERP-backwards analysis: 'komunitas vespa jogja' returns editorial community-profile results (a rider wants to find a club); 'cara dapat sponsor event komunitas' returns 100% procedural how-to guides. The page's title/meta pitch a directory; its H1 and hero pitch a B2B sponsor-matching service. Neither searcher intent is served. Persona score for 'rider looking for a club': 26/100.
findings.recommendation: Pick one primary intent for the title+H1 (recommend keeping the sponsor-matching pitch, since that is the actual business model per project context) and move the directory-browsing use case to a clearly labeled secondary section rather than contesting the title tag.

findings.title: /marketplace/ and /marketplace/semua/ advertise zero inventory to first-pass crawlers
findings.description: Static HTML ships literal empty-state copy ('Belum Ada Listing Saat Ini... Jadi penjual pertama di sini') while the API returns 15 live listings. Every ranking competitor for 'jual vespa yogyakarta' (OLX, Tokopedia, Shopee, mobil123) encodes city/model in the URL path; VespaKita has zero city- or model-scoped browse URLs -- /marketplace/ and /marketplace/semua/ are the only two browse endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Server-render the listing grid (see Technical finding above) and consider city-scoped or model-scoped landing paths matching the URL pattern every ranking competitor already uses.

findings.title: /komunitas/c/{id} community profile pages have no H1 and no schema
findings.description: Exactly the page format that dominates the head-term community SERP, shipped with no H1 element and no structured data.
findings.recommendation: Add a proper H1 (community name) and Organization/Club JSON-LD to the profile template.

findings.title: /marketplace/l/{id} titles omit high-intent keywords
findings.description: Sampled title reads 'Exclusive 2 Tahun 2001' -- missing 'Vespa', 'bekas', and the city, which are exactly the terms searchers type and which every competing result includes.
findings.recommendation: Extend the title template to '{model} {year} Bekas - {city} | VespaKita Marketplace' or similar.

findings.title: Brand entity ambiguity across three Instagram-style handles
findings.description: Google surfaces @vespakita.co for brand queries; the site's own Organization schema references @ves_pakita and @VespaKitaSemua elsewhere. Three distinct-looking handles compete for the same brand identity.
findings.recommendation: Standardize on one handle across schema, footer, and social links so Google can confidently resolve the brand entity.

findings.title: Content-quality/E-E-A-T pass did not complete
findings.description: The dedicated content-quality subagent crawled all 49 sitemap pages successfully but was stopped by its analysis turn-limit before writing findings. Only indirect signals are available: SXO's page inventory recorded static word counts of 642 (homepage), 254 (/marketplace/), 106 (/komunitas/), 86 (listing detail), and 137 (community profile) -- thin by conventional standards for pages meant to rank competitively, though these are largely client-rendered pages so true rendered word count is higher.
findings.recommendation: Re-run a dedicated content-quality pass (E-E-A-T signals, author/byline presence, thin-content risk on the templated /komunitas/c/{id} and /marketplace/l/{id} pages, ID/EN duplicate-content risk) before treating this category as audited.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid Product+Offer+Brand JSON-LD on marketplace listing pages, all fields parse correctly
Organization schema present on homepage

findings.title: No structured data on community profile pages
findings.description: Confirmed independently by both the Technical and Schema passes: /komunitas/c/{id} ships no JSON-LD at all.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization/Club schema mirroring the pattern already proven on marketplace listings.

findings.title: Schema audit stopped at its turn-limit before full completion
findings.description: The dedicated schema subagent completed its analysis pass and had begun writing final recommendations (BreadcrumbList, WebSite/SearchAction, Event schema for community event postings) when it hit its turn limit. Its findings.md file exists but should be treated as not fully finalized.
findings.recommendation: Review findings/schema.md directly for the fuller (if unfinished) writeup; consider a short follow-up pass to close it out.

findings.title: Dedicated Core Web Vitals measurement pass did not complete
findings.description: The performance subagent confirmed Cloudinary's w_800,q_auto,f_auto transform is correctly applied to listing/community images before stopping at its turn limit, without producing measured LCP/INP/CLS numbers. A prior, separate scan (not from this run) had flagged three autoplaying hero videos at 19MB, 5.8MB, and 1.2MB as a likely major LCP risk -- this has not been re-verified as part of the current audit and should be treated as unconfirmed carryover, not fresh data.
findings.recommendation: Re-run a dedicated performance pass with real Lighthouse/CrUX measurement before acting on the video-size figure; if still accurate, re-encode to under 3MB with a poster image and preload="none".

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: Detail pages (marketplace listings, community profiles) are server-rendered and in the sitemap, giving AI crawlers that skip JS at least a path to the highest-value individual pages

robots.txt Content-Signal explicitly sets use=reference (permits AI citation with attribution) and leaves ai-input unset (does not refuse RAG) -- the declared policy intent is more open than what is actually enforced

findings.title: ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, and Claude search bots get a live HTTP 403, separate from and worse than robots.txt
findings.description: Live user-agent probing confirms OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, and Claude-SearchBot all receive 403 from a Cloudflare WAF/AI Crawl Control rule, even though robots.txt explicitly allows all five. Generic bots, curl, and unrelated user-agents get 200 -- this is a targeted AI-crawler blocklist, not general bot mitigation. Reading robots.txt alone gives a false sense that these platforms can see the site.
findings.recommendation: This needs to change in the Cloudflare dashboard (AI Crawl Control / WAF), not in robots.txt -- editing robots.txt will not fix it. Allow the five AI search agents; nothing else moves ChatGPT/Perplexity/Claude visibility until this lands.

findings.title: Blocking Google-Extended/Applebot-Extended does NOT affect Google AI Overviews or Apple Intelligence/Siri as commonly assumed
findings.description: AI Overviews follows Googlebot (confirmed 200), not Google-Extended; Applebot (not Applebot-Extended) also returns 200. A prior pass's finding that this block 'defeats AI Overviews visibility' is corrected here -- it does not. Google-Extended and Applebot-Extended are training-only signals; blocking them is a defensible content-protection choice independent of AI-search visibility.
findings.recommendation: No action needed on this specific point; do not conflate it with the WAF-block finding above.

findings.title: No single crawlable sentence states what VespaKita is
findings.description: The three business pillars (media brand / marketplace / community sponsor-matching) each live on separate pages and are never combined into one passage. No About page exists in the sitemap or repo. An LLM asked 'what is VespaKita' would likely describe it as a podcast/Instagram account only.
findings.recommendation: Add one clear, quotable paragraph (ideally on the homepage and in Organization.description) stating all three pillars together.

findings.title: Very low passage-level citability
findings.description: Extracted static prose across sampled pages: homepage 154 words total, marketplace 106, komunitas 61, tongkrongan 48 -- zero text blocks fall in the 134-167 word band that citation-friendly passages typically need; the longest single block anywhere is 44 words.
findings.recommendation: Write substantive, self-contained paragraphs (120-160 words) answering the obvious questions each page exists to answer, in server-rendered HTML.

findings.title: Client-fetched hub pages are invisible to non-JS AI crawlers
findings.description: Same root cause as the Technical and SXO findings: /marketplace/ (0 of 15 listings visible pre-JS), /komunitas/ (0 of 3 communities visible pre-JS), and the homepage event feed are all fetch()-populated. AI search crawlers that do not execute JavaScript see empty containers.
findings.recommendation: Same fix as Technical finding #3 -- server-render these hubs. This single fix resolves three independently-raised findings across three specialist passes at once.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Cloudinary w_800,q_auto,f_auto transform correctly applied to listing/community thumbnail images (confirmed by the performance pass before it stopped)

findings.title: No explicit width/height on images
findings.description: 0 of 38 homepage tags carry a width attribute -- direct CLS risk, confirmed by the Technical pass.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit dimensions or aspect-ratio CSS.

findings.title: Inconsistent lazy-loading
findings.description: Only 17 of 38 homepage images have loading="lazy".
findings.recommendation: Extend to all below-the-fold images.

categories.name: Sitemap
what_works: Sitemap is dynamically generated from the live D1 database, self-updating as content is published/removed
hreflang reciprocity is 100% correct across all 20 id/en pairs that carry hreflang
Both /marketplace/admin/ and /komunitas/admin/ correctly excluded from the sitemap
No 404s, redirects, or duplicate URLs among the 49 live-checked entries; well under size limits

findings.title: /rate-card/ is a live, unprotected 'Draft Internal' page
findings.description: Returns 200, titled 'VespaKita — Rate Card (Draft Internal)'. Not linked from nav, not in the sitemap, but has no noindex meta tag and no robots.txt block -- nothing prevents it from being crawled and indexed.
findings.recommendation: Add noindex,nofollow and a robots.txt disallow (or an auth-gate) if it must stay internal.

findings.title: /komunitas/tongkrongan/admin/ has no indexation protection
findings.description: A third admin tool, distinct from the two already protected. Confirmed password-gated (not a raw security hole) but has no noindex meta tag and is not in robots.txt Disallow, unlike its two sibling admin pages.
findings.recommendation: Add noindex,nofollow to match the other two admin pages, and add the path to robots.txt.

findings.title: /marketplace/admin/ combines robots.txt Disallow with a noindex meta tag
findings.description: Known anti-pattern -- the robots.txt block prevents crawlers from ever fetching the page to see the noindex directive.
findings.recommendation: Keep only the noindex meta tag; drop the robots.txt line (or accept the low residual risk given it is low-traffic and password-gated).

findings.title: /marketplace/semua/ ships with zero hreflang tags
findings.description: A live, daily-changefreq core filter page with no hreflang annotation at all, inconsistent with its sibling /marketplace/.
findings.recommendation: Ship /en/marketplace/semua/ with reciprocal hreflang, or add a self-referencing pair in the meantime.

findings.title: /60s-yogyakarta/ and /vw-yogyakarta/ lack hreflang tags
findings.description: Present in the sitemap (confirmed, not missing) but carry no hreflang, inconsistent with every other entry. Correct as-is since neither page has an /en/ counterpart -- flagged only for consistency.
findings.recommendation: Add self-referencing hreflang for consistency, or leave as-is if these two legacy pages are being sunset.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Disable Cloudflare Pages SPA-fallback / ship a real 404.html (fixes sitewide soft-404s)
Add vespakita.com -> www.vespakita.com redirect at the Cloudflare edge
Allow OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Claude-SearchBot in Cloudflare AI Crawl Control / WAF (dashboard setting, not robots.txt)
Add noindex,nofollow + robots.txt disallow to /rate-card/ and /komunitas/tongkrongan/admin/
Resolve the /komunitas/ intent inversion: pick sponsor-matching as the primary title/H1 intent

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Server-render /komunitas/, /marketplace/semua/, and the homepage event widget (single fix resolves 3+ findings across Technical/SXO/GEO)
Add an H1 and Organization/Club JSON-LD to /komunitas/c/{id} profile pages
Extend /marketplace/l/{id} titles to include model + 'bekas' + city
Add explicit width/height (or aspect-ratio) to all images; extend loading="lazy" sitewide
Add HSTS/CSP/X-Frame-Options headers via a Cloudflare Pages _headers file

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Re-run the Content Quality and Performance specialist passes to completion (both were cut off at their turn limit this round)
Write one clear, quotable 120-160 word paragraph stating VespaKita's three pillars together (homepage + About-style section)
Standardize on a single Instagram/social handle across schema and footer
Add IndexNow ping on new listing/community publish
Consider city- or model-scoped marketplace browse URLs matching the pattern every ranking competitor already uses

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Connect Google Search Console + confirm GA4 (G-6LLXWQ6MMM) is capturing the new /komunitas/ and marketplace traffic
Re-run this audit after Phase 1-2 fixes to confirm score improvement and close out the incomplete categories

Spot-check marketplace listing quality/pricing against real market rates as part of the existing manual-vetting process -- the SXO pass flagged one live listing priced well above its comparable market band with description text that reads as possibly machine-translated
